response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total, AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT c.SEX, c.n AS test_records, c.n * 1.0 / t.total AS share_of_total, c.n - t.avg_n AS above_average FROM c, t WHERE c.n > t.avg_n
